prompt:
Create an image: a studio still-life photograph of a small physical sculpture, for the website of a live-captioning app. The sculpture is a row of evenly spaced thin vertical bars of matte anodised graphite aluminium standing upright on a dark surface, arranged left to right like a sound waveform: tall and irregular on the left, like a speaking voice, then gradually shorter towards the middle. Exactly at the horizontal centre of the image, the bars lie down and continue to the right as four neatly aligned horizontal rows of short rounded bars of varying length, like lines of subtitles. One of the four rows is in satin mint-green enamel (#5ad1a0); the other three are pale frosted glass. Every bar is one clean, solid, separate piece with a rounded end; no fragments, no floating pieces, no bars merging. The idea: spoken sound becoming lines of written captions, rendered as a quiet object.

Style and medium: high-end product photography, shot from slightly above at a gentle three-quarter angle, 85 mm lens, the whole sculpture in crisp focus. Soft, directional window light from the upper left, gentle soft shadows falling to the lower right, real materials with fine surface texture. Minimal, tactile, premium, in the spirit of an industrial-design catalogue.

Composition: wide 16:9 banner. The sculpture is centred horizontally, its waveform on the left half and its caption rows on the right half, and sits slightly above the vertical middle, with calm breathing room on every side: about one eighth of the width empty on the left and on the right, and nothing touches an edge. The bottom third holds only the dark surface and soft shadow. The background is a deep, even charcoal, #191d23 at the top darkening to #0e1013 at the bottom, so the picture can fade seamlessly into a dark web page.

Palette: charcoal and graphite neutrals, one restrained accent of mint green #5ad1a0, and soft off-white #e9ebef. Low saturation, high craft.

Avoid: no text, letters, numbers or pseudo-writing of any kind, no logos, no flags, no people or faces, no microphones, headphones, screens, phones or devices, no app interface, no neon glow, no lens flare, no bokeh, no mirror reflections, no sci-fi or "digital" particles, no watermark, no border.
postprocess: Rendered at 2560x1440, resized to 1920x1080 with Pillow Lanczos. docs/assets/hero.jpg (1600x900) and .github/social-preview-art.jpg (1120x400) are crops of the same render, with the floor outside the sculpture masked and the black point set to 36 so the ground is pure black (the home page blends it with mix-blend-mode: lighten).
